college_identity.identity_notes: One of ten new NITs established 2010, mentored initially by NIT Agartala. Started at a temporary campus at Government Polytechnic, Takyelpat, Imphal, with only three branches (EE, ECE, CSE); later expanded to five branches and moved to its permanent campus (~341.5 acres) at Langol, Imphal, near Lamphelpat Lake. Explicitly verified DISTINCT from Manipur Institute of Technology (MIT) — a separate, older (est. 1998), state institution that is a constituent college of Manipur University — and from IIIT Manipur (Senapati) — a separate, newer public-private-partnership institute. A Shiksha review for the separate MIT institution was identified during search and correctly excluded from this extraction.
